prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred working style. I can recommend specific agencies, but first it helps to know what you need.

Quick questions so I can make a tailored recommendation:
- What are your main goals? (e.g., lead generation, ecommerce revenue, brand awareness, app installs, SEO organic growth)
- Which channels matter most? (PPC/Google Ads, SEO, social media paid/organic, content, email, CRO, web design)
- Monthly budget or annual marketing budget?
- Company stage and vertical? (startup, SMB, enterprise; B2B or B2C; industry)
- Do you prefer a local SF agency (in-person) or are remote/remote-first fine?
- Timeline / KPIs you need to hit?

How to pick the “best” agency — checklist I use when vetting:
- Relevant case studies with concrete metrics (traffic, leads, revenue lift, ROAS)
- Client references you can call
- Clear scope, deliverables and KPIs in the SOW
- Reporting cadence and transparency (dashboards, raw data access)
- Team and tooling (who will do the work, their experience, tools used)
- Industry experience / vertical expertise
- Pricing model and flexibility (retainer, % of ad spend, project)
- Trial project or short initial commitment to validate fit
- Cultural fit & communication style

Red flags:
- Guarantees of #1 rankings or unrealistic promises
- Vague deliverables or “secret sauce” answers
- No references or case studies
- Poor responsiveness during sales process

Ballpark pricing (San Francisco market):
- SEO retainers: $2k–$15k+/month depending on scope and competition
- Paid media management: often 10–20% of ad spend or $1k–$10k+/month
- Full-service (multi-channel) retainers: $5k–$50k+/month
- Website builds: $10k–$200k+ depending on complexity

Resources to find and compare agencies:
- Clutch.co and G2 reviews
- Google Partner directory (for PPC expertise)
- LinkedIn and industry referrals
- Local meetups / startup communities for personal recommendations

If you want, tell me the answers to those questions and I’ll shortlist 4–6 highly rated San Francisco agencies that match your needs (with pros/cons and what to ask each one). Which channels and budget are you targeting?
